description: NYSERDA Electric Vehicle Drive Clean Rebate Data: Beginning 2017 is a dataset listed in State of New York open data portal (data.ny.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of New York. New York State’s Charge NY initiative offers electric car buyers the Drive Clean Rebate of up to $2,000 for new car purchases or leases. The rebate amount depends on the battery-only range of each vehicle. Coverage: New York State. The portal files it under the category Energy & Environment. Its tags are drive clean rebate, electric vehicle, ghg, plug-in, phev. The table has 11 columns. Attribution on the portal: New York State Energy Research and Development Authority (NYSERDA). The portal shows 2026-09-01 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-ny-gov-portal.
